purpose: generate a design-specific command dispatcher with fixed command-BRAM, MM2S, S2MM and unified bank-ownership infrastructure plus marked user executor extension regions

fixed_architecture.command_source: PS writes a separate command BRAM through AXI BRAM Controller Port A
fixed_architecture.dispatcher_command_port: native synchronous BRAM Port B signals cmd_enb cmd_addrb cmd_doutb
fixed_architecture.bank_ownership: one exclusive acquire owner code, release pulse and busy bit per data bank
fixed_architecture.issue_policy: strict current-PC in-order issue; advance after request acceptance; no lookahead
fixed_architecture.outstanding_policy: multiple nonconflicting commands limited by unified bank busy and executor ready
fixed_architecture.completion_policy: responses release banks independently of current PC
fixed_architecture.terminal_policy: END drains pending commands and bank busy before DONE

parameter_legality: MAX_COMMANDS is at least 1 and no greater than 2^CMD_ADDR_WIDTH
CMD_DATA_WIDTH is at least OPCODE_WIDTH + 3*BANK_NUM_WIDTH + BANK_ADDR_WIDTH + BTT_WIDTH + AXI_ADDR_WIDTH

instruction_record.packing: contiguous from CMD_DATA_WIDTH-1 downward; any remaining least-significant bits are reserved

fixed_opcode_semantics.END: has no operand bank and begins drain without an executor request
fixed_opcode_semantics.MM2S: operand0_bank is destination data bank; AXI address is DDR source; tag is zero-extended operand0_bank
fixed_opcode_semantics.S2MM: operand0_bank is source data bank; AXI address is DDR destination; tag is zero-extended operand0_bank

fixed_legality: MM2S and S2MM require operand0_bank less than BANK_NUM
MM2S and S2MM require nonzero byte_count

extension_rules: Agents copy the template into a design revision and edit only between matching USER markers.
User executor operands are logical bank IDs and never local raw addresses.
Every user request valid is independent of executor ready and stable until acceptance.
All distinct operand banks are acquired atomically on user request acceptance.
Every acquired bank is released exactly once by the matching completion or shared reset.
Extensions must add self-checking simulation and fresh synthesis evidence; template evidence does not transfer to generated modules.

required_cases: command BRAM address zero is independent of data bank zero
data bank zero may be acquired released and reused
two MM2S commands to distinct banks issue before completion
MM2S and S2MM to distinct banks may both remain pending
valid and typed payload remain stable under ready backpressure
completion releases during later fetch or stall
spurious or mismatched status never releases a bank
END waits for pending entries and bank_busy to clear
reset clears pending state and pulses
all required USER markers occur exactly once and in begin/end order

does_not_claim: AXI BRAM Controller instantiation or address assignment
user compute executor ports or behavior
board integration bitstream or physical-board validation
